patterns.note: Asymmetric content blocks are used for project showcases, alternating large visual elements with concise text descriptions on opposing sides of the page.
Headings utilize an extremely oversized, bold, and condensed sans-serif typeface, creating a strong, almost brutalist visual impact that contrasts with smaller, more functional body text.

The site employs a high-contrast dark mode, predominantly using deep black backgrounds with stark white text, punctuated by subtle, vibrant blue accents within interactive elements and project visuals.

A dramatic scroll-triggered effect causes the main page content to progressively disappear into a solid black background as the user scrolls down, leaving only the sticky header. Further scrolling then reveals the footer content emerging from the bottom of this black void.
The 'Featured Projects' section emphasizes large, full-bleed visual assets (images or videos) for each project, with minimal text, allowing the work itself to dominate the presentation.

technique_notes: The site implements a unique scroll-driven content transition where the primary page content appears to recede or fade into a solid black background as the user scrolls down. This effect, potentially leveraging the detected canvas animation technology, creates a sense of depth and mystery before the footer content is revealed by sliding or fading up from the bottom of the black screen.

Project showcases are built with large, impactful visual media that span significant width, often full-bleed, paired with concise textual descriptions. This creates a strong visual hierarchy where the 'work' is the primary focus.

Typography is used as a core design element, employing a very large, bold, and condensed sans-serif for headlines to establish a strong, modern, and almost industrial aesthetic, while body text maintains high legibility with a more neutral sans-serif.

design_tokens.type_scale: Extremely oversized, bold, condensed sans-serif headings (~4-5x body) create a powerful visual statement, contrasted with smaller, legible body and navigation text.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp (predominantly 0px), contributing to a modern, angular, and precise aesthetic.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy in the hero and between major sections, providing ample negative space, while content within project cards is more balanced.

standout: The most distinctive design element is the dramatic scroll-triggered content disappearance into a black void, followed by the footer's emergence. This creates a unique, immersive, and almost theatrical user experience that goes beyond typical scroll animations. The bold, almost brutalist typography also sets it apart from generic modern templates.
